name: Pools to final — expression-session heats of up to 10, top N to one final
description: Every rider rides once in a pool heat (up to 10 riders, 12-15 min). All riders are ranked across pools by heat total using the division's scoring model; the top N go to a single final. Suited to amateur/intermediate divisions and to days with little wind time. Inspired by PUKL Division 2.5.
basedOn: PUKL Division 2.5 (heats of up to 10, expression-session style)
